_comment: Tier-2 for kratos.dem::11: unknown top-level keys and unknown keys inside solver_settings are rejected by ValidateAndAssignDefaults, and a typo nested inside any other sub-block is silently ignored. Executed 2026-08-07 on Kratos 10.4.3 with three decks. Measured: 'MaxTimestep' (lowercase s) raises RuntimeError 'The item with name "MaxTimestep" is present in this Parameters but NOT in the default values'; an unknown key under solver_settings raises the same class of error from sphere_strategy's own four-key default; and 'not_a_key_either' nested inside BoundingBoxServoLoadingSettings is accepted, the run completing with ANALYSIS COMPLETED and exit 0. INTERPRETER: needs a Kratos build carrying DEMApplication; set KRATOS_PYTHON=/mnt/kratos-tier2/kv/bin/python (the 28-application source build). The repo venv wheel does not import at all on this host (GLIBC_2.32 against a 2.31 system) and /usr/bin/python3 carries no DEMApplication, so pointing this anywhere else SKIPS rather than passes. Every deck is written into a fresh TemporaryDirectory and driven through DEMAnalysisStage in a CHILD process: Kratos logs from C++ and buffers it, so an in-process capture would miss every DEM line, and a Finalize()d DEM stage cannot be probed from python without segfaulting. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): see the module docstring -- the mutation changes the INPUT only, never an assertion, so every deck is still really executed against Kratos. Verified 2026-08-07: unmutated PASSES (rc=0) with probe_mismatches=0; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1), the named probe lines flip and the trailing =ok line disappears. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/dem_unknown_keys_rejected_but_only_at_the_top && $KRATOS_PYTHON source.py, then T2_MUTATE=1 $KRATOS_PYTHON source.py. NOTE ON forbid_in_output: the sentinel is FIXTURE_FAILED, not MISMATCH. The runner's matcher is case-insensitive substring, so forbidding 'MISMATCH' also matches the 'probe_mismatches=0' line this fixture prints on SUCCESS, and every passing run would be recorded as failed. Found by running these fixtures through scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py rather than by hand.
